items.title: Danny Barker Interview, 1959-06-30
items.q: I wonder if we could get the name of some of the different guys in your Boozang, King, Boozang, and I was Joe Francis' Uncle Zoo. Russell on little makeshift drums.

ctx.x: I wonder if we could get the name of some of the different guys in your Boozang, King, Boozang,

and I was Joe Francis' Uncle Zoo. Russell on little makeshift drums. Myself, and Harmon Henderson, who was a terrific ukulele player. Played a little piano. His mother was a midwife and he went to school and, real educated little kid. Well raised. But they were trying to raise him like a mama's boy. Did all the housewaves, he had to cook while his mother's father was away. And I sneaked him up in the district a couple of times, played with us. Mother found out what would have made him quit the group. She wanted…
Who were the outstanding, say, clarinet players when you were here for writing music?
